gaps.explanation: Budgetary Comparison Schedule - General Fund (all governmental funds by department, pp9-12) prints 'Loan repayment' among charges to appropriations: Fire 2,703 and Economic Development 19,553 (p11); total charges 806,069 (p12). The governmental funds statement prints the same amounts under Other financing sources (uses) 'Loan repayments': Econ Dev (19,553), Other Governmental Funds (2,703), Total (22,256) (p5); Total expenditures 783,813 (p5). 806,069 - 2,703 - 19,553 = 783,813; gap 22,256 is exactly this classification difference. No fix.

Statement Transfers from other funds per fund column: Street 56,373 (p4) + Econ Dev 36,098 + Police 194,805 + Housing 38,201 + Other Governmental Funds 37,328 (p5) = 362,805 (Total column 362,805, p5). The budget schedule treats all governmental funds as one budgetary 'General Fund' and prints only the net transfer from outside the governmental funds: 'Transfers from other funds' actual 45,000 (p10), already in detail. 362,805 - 45,000 = 317,805 = gap; this is interfund transfers netted on the schedule (statement transfers out are 317,805, so the statement's own net is 45,000). No fix.

Statement Transfers to other funds: General (285,936) + Parks & Rec (31,869) (p4) = (317,805), Total column (317,805) p5. The budget schedule (one budgetary fund for all governmental funds) prints 'Transfers to other funds' actual '-' (p12, budget 5,679): the 317,805 of interfund transfers out is netted against transfers in (362,805 - 317,805 = 45,000 printed on p10). No fix.
